submission.natural_language_explanation: The negative pole fires on an explicit count of a collection: the numeral in a clause that states how many things there are - 'there are N X', 'X has/holds/contains N Y', 'we counted N X', 'N X were Y' - and on the head noun that numeral quantifies, peaking hardest when the count is asserted to be small ('only N X'). It is quiet on numerals used as labels, ordinals, years, versions or copular values ('Chapter 6', 'in 1989', 'version 2.5', 'the value is 300', 'the answer is 6'), on generic uncounted plurals ('Horses are mammals' = 0.11), and on comparator quantifiers ('more than N', 'fewer than N'); in wiki markup the same pole also peaks on the class-label token inside a 'Category:' block (e.g. 'People' in 'Category:People from ...' = 2.1 versus 'Places' = 0.7).

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The archive was catalogued in 1989, and the manual's last revision was version 2.5.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Year and version numerals are named by the hypothesis as quiet, even though a numeral sits in a copular clause of an archival topic.

adversarial_test_results.detail: Copular numeral values matching the hypothesis's own quiet examples ('the value is 300', 'the answer is 6'), and the exact claimed token '6' appears here in that quiet role.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: From the autumn of that year the prisoners were moved at night. Guards woke whole barracks before dawn, read a list of surnames aloud, and marched the named men to the rail siding without explanation. The victims were taken to a clearing beyond the forest and shot in batches, and the graves were filled by the same men who had dug them. Families in the nearby villages learned nothing for months; letters sent to the district office were returned unanswered. When the war ended, a commission travelled through the region and interviewed whoever remained, though many witnesses could not recall exact dates. Investigators worked from the testimony of a retired clerk who had kept a private notebook of the deportations. He repeated that the victims were ordinary men, seized from farms and workshops, and that the officers who signed the orders had used code names. The clearing was marked only by a wooden post, and the forest slowly reclaimed it. Decades later, schoolchildren were brought to the site and told that the victims were Polish officers and intellectuals, though the regional museum never published a full register. The records that survived were partial, and the gaps have never been resolved. When the memorial was dedicated, the speakers avoided any claim about the scale of the killing, saying only that the site deserved to be remembered, and the crowd stood in silence until the sun went down behind the pines.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Long passage on the same mass-execution topic as two top examples, loaded with 'were' and 'only' but with no numeral count at all, so the hypothesis predicts quiet.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Climate stations along the northern coast were installed during the 1950s, and the earliest logbooks are held at the university in a climate-controlled room. Researchers spent the winter of 1998 digitising the sheets, and the project continued through 2004 before funding lapsed. The instruments recorded temperature, rainfall and wind speed, though the anemometers were replaced at least twice and the calibration slips were lost. More than 30 stations reported gaps in the record, and fewer than 5 percent of the daily entries were later corrected from duplicates held at a second archive. A doctoral student compared the earlier transcripts with the originals and found the handwriting often ambiguous. The committee reviewing the dataset noted that the reference values differed between the printed edition and the online edition, and that the change of reference period had altered many published anomaly maps. They recommended that the series be re-released with a full history of the corrections, and that users be warned about the discontinuities introduced when the observatory moved from its old site to the new one. The final report was long, was printed in a limited run, and is now consulted mostly by historians of science rather than by forecasters.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Long passage dense with years, plural nouns, 'were' and comparator quantifiers ('more than 30', 'fewer than 5 percent') but no explicit count assertion, all of which the hypothesis marks quiet.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The excavation began in the spring and ran for eleven weeks under a canvas shelter. Students cleared the topsoil in spits, sieving every bucket and bagging the finds by context. The supervisor kept a running inventory in a notebook, and at the end of each day the totals were copied into the site register. Most of the pottery was coarse ware, undecorated and badly weathered, and the bone was too fragmentary to identify. The team catalogued 1,208 fragments of pottery before the weather turned, a figure the supervisor expected to double once the washing was finished. Nothing suggested a substantial building; the trenches exposed a scatter of postholes, a shallow ditch and a hearth. A coin of the later empire came up near the ditch, and the conservator was called to lift it in a block of soil. Visitors from the county society were shown the trenches on the final weekend, and the supervisor explained that the site had probably been a farmstead rather than a villa. The finds were packed into crates and sent to the museum store, where they waited through the winter for a specialist to examine the coarse ware. The published report was short, and its appendix listed every context with a brief description, but the pottery itself remained in storage, and the supervisor retired before the analysis was complete.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Long-context holdout with an explicit count assertion buried mid-passage, testing the hypothesis when the count sits far from any probe edge.
